decisions.note: Round 4 search matched only title/description; client asked for site/url matching too, which REF-BM-12 requires.
Round 4 card showed title/site/description/date only; client asked for tag labels and a favicon per REF-BM-07.
Rounds 5-6 search required exact contiguous substrings (failed on spaces/word-order); client insisted on tolerant multi-word full-text matching, fixed by round 7.
Round 8: version C conflated tag-filtering with plain text search, risking false matches vs true tag membership; client selected version B, which correctly implements REF-BM-11.
Round 10 tag entry only listed existing tags for reuse, without prefix-narrowing; client asked for typeahead narrowing (REF-BM-10), added round 11.
Round 10: maker offered page-summary-only vs personal-note-only vs both; client selected 'both' plus searchability, matching the reference's distinct description+note fields.
Round 10: re-pasting a saved url created a duplicate; client supplied the correct behavior (recognize duplicate, open existing) per REF-BM-06.
Round 11: duplicate-catch only displayed the existing item; client asked to land in an editable state, matching REF-BM-06's 'guide to edit' wording.
Round 11: no general way to open/edit any saved bookmark existed yet; client asked for it, per REF-BM-04.
Round 12: edit panel locked the url field; client asked to unlock url editing, which REF-BM-04 includes.
Round 12: no delete function existed; client asked for permanent delete, required by REF-BM-05.
Round 13: only permanent delete existed, no reversible archive; client asked for a distinct 'set aside' (archive) option, matching REF-BM-26/27/28 which had never been surfaced.
Round 17: sort order was fixed to newest-first with no user control; client asked for a switchable, persisted sort key, per REF-BM-22.
Round 19: 'read later' was just an ordinary user-managed tag that would 'rot'; client specified the correct dedicated unread/read state with auto-clearing pile, exactly REF-BM-17/18/19.

Round 21: auto-fill of metadata only worked for a handful of known sites, not general pages as REF-BM-02 requires; maker disclosed and offered to defer, client selected to prioritize full auto-fill next rather than 'someday'.
